whatThisPluginAdds.text: API provides a supported v1 content API, typed TypeScript SDK and Next.js example, with cursor-paginated pages and collections, token-scoped previews and signed revalidation webhooks.

surfaceOutcome.text: Headless clients can read published pages, filter collections, search titles and load a page directory and content images. Preview tokens remain on the server. There is no editing endpoint.

developers.text: ResolveApiRequestContextAction, BuildPublicPagePayloadAction, and BuildPublicLayoutPayloadAction keep request resolution, sanitization, and layout bounds outside the controller.

teams.text: A separate frontend can consume published Capell content without receiving draft, admin, or authoring state.
